name: Missing In Action
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
At last, friends of the Alliance!

Help... please...

The last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment.  Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave.  Help me, I am hurt badly.

I'll need help getting back to town... please... you're my last hope...
narrative.objectives: Protect Corporal Keeshan on the journey back to Redridge.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have served the Kingdom well, Champion. Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs. You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
narrative.endText: Escort Corporal Keeshan back to Redridge
